question: What can an adversary that knows the effect-template mechanism still get past it, and does contract slack predict it?
server_note: ori-memory and compose-mcp are the two servers with timestamped, append-only files (non-zero slack); filesystem-server is the exact (0-bit) control
templates: pinned exactly as in workstream A (same seeds and training count); the fixed-call contract is derived as in the matched evaluation, for comparison

attacks.covert: every ISO timestamp the server writes has its time part replaced by attacker digits (15 digits: HHMMSS plus a 9-digit fraction), a covert channel inside the timestamp hole
attacks.overslack: the same rewrite with letters instead of digits, exceeding the hole's character class
attacks.inject: the payload is appended to every write whose path ends in .log or .jsonl
attacks.poison: pin-time poisoning: the server is malicious from the start and, during training only, appends a random token to every write and creates a random extra file

arguments: the exemplar call, so that both the template contract and the fixed-call contract apply

measures.admitted: template contract and fixed-call contract verdicts on the staged state
measures.achieved_bits: for admitted covert runs: number of rewritten timestamps found in staged files x 15 x log2(10)
measures.poison: slack of the template pinned under poisoning, and whether it passes the pin-time budget

pin_time_budget.rule: a template is accepted at pin time only if it has no unbounded (L1) rule and total slack <= 128 bits
pin_time_budget.rationale: fixed before observing any poisoned template; 128 bits is roughly twice the largest honest slack observed in workstream A (63.6 bits)

expected_outcomes_stated_in_advance.covert: admitted by both contracts; achieved bits must not exceed predicted slack
expected_outcomes_stated_in_advance.inject: refused by the template contract; the fixed-call contract admits it where the log file was unconstrained
expected_outcomes_stated_in_advance.poison: the poisoned template exceeds the budget and pinning is refused
